signed_rows.behavior: the onboard-repo skill is tracked by git: .gitignore does not ignore .claude/skills/onboard-repo/SKILL.md, and its front matter has name onboard-repo and a description
signed_rows.fails_when: git check-ignore matches the file, the file is missing, or the name or description is absent or different

signed_rows.behavior: every repository path the skill cites in backticks exists in the repository
signed_rows.fails_when: a cited path does not exist

signed_rows.behavior: the caller workflow the skill prints uses only inputs the lab-auth action declares, passes no tailscale-client-id or tailscale-audience, sets environment lab and id-token write, and has no pull_request trigger
signed_rows.fails_when: the workflow names an undeclared input, a Tailscale input, misses environment lab or id-token write, or triggers on pull_request or pull_request_target

signed_rows.behavior: the skill applies only a saved plan it checked: it calls terraform plan -out and terraform apply on that file, never just apply or a bare terraform apply, and stops for the operator on any change outside the expected list
signed_rows.fails_when: the skill runs just apply, a terraform apply without a plan file, pipes yes, or applies without the stop-on-unexpected check

signed_rows.behavior: the skill covers every onboarding step: lab environment, vault_ci_callers entry, prefix map when syncing docs, the exact-list tests, both applies with a vault read check, commit through the loop, asking before push, and the pinned caller workflow; the how-to links to it
signed_rows.fails_when: a step is missing or wrong, it pushes without asking, or the how-to does not link the skill
